[ opt ] --watch mode (knowcode server --watch):
FileMonitor.start() + BackgroundIndexer.start()
On file change → index_file(path) [incremental, re-runs steps 16→21 for changed file only]
POST /api/v1/reload → service.reload() → re-reads KnowledgeStore from disk
